brand.name: Humble Brands
brand.tagline: Aluminum-free deodorant with real essential oil scents
brand.story: Santa Fe-born clean deodorant built around essential oils, baking soda and baking-soda-free formulas, plus plastic-free paperboard options - everyday odor protection without aluminum.

products.name: Palo Santo & Frankincense Deodorant
products.description: Aluminum-free Deodorant. Scent intensity 5/5 - Bold Masculine.
products.howToUse: Apply 2-3 swipes to underarms and rub in any excess. Do not apply to broken skin. Patch test before use. If irritation occurs, discontinue use.
